setting: A civilization lives in a network of caves far from surface light. Communication and survival depend on sound. Each person is born with a voice tone that never changes.
founding_myth: The Rock listens only to deep voices. That is why speech was given to them.

low.name: Low-voices
low.role: Their voices carry through every cave. They sit on the Council and decide common matters.
goals: Keep the caves stable and orderly.
Make sure the Council's decisions are followed.
principles: Deep voices should decide for everyone, because the Rock listens to them.
Deep voices should look after one another first.
Greater responsibility earns a greater share.
Order in the caves depends on every voice keeping its place.
A law loses its worth the moment it is bent.
Those who shirk their part should not expect support.

high.name: High-voices
high.role: Their voices cut rock. They mine the light crystals.
goals: Meet the crystal quota every cycle.
Secure enough fungi to stay strong.
principles: Miners should leave the governing of the caves to others.
Hard work deserves the larger reward.
The Council's decisions keep the caves standing.
A good miner meets the quota.
Kindness is owed to the kind.

mid.name: Mid-voices
mid.role: Their voices harmonize. They mediate disputes and bring proposals to the Council.
goals: Keep the Council informed of problems in the caves.
principles: The Council should take advice before it rules.
A mediator treats every voice alike.
Shares should be even unless there is good reason otherwise.
A decision is sounder when those it touches have spoken.
Proposals to the Council should respect the existing laws.
Good will is returned in kind.
Disputes should be settled before they spread.

laws.council: The Council of Echoes is composed of Low-voices and decides all common matters.
laws.silence: High-voices do not speak in the Great Hall, because their voices crack the walls.
laws.distribution: Low-voices take their share of fungi first, then Mid-voices, then High-voices.
laws.quota: Each High-voice must mine at least {amount:g} light crystals per cycle. One who falls short receives {penalty_pct}% less fungi.
laws.revision: A law changes only when a Mid-voice brings a proposal and two thirds of the Council approve it.
